sentences.jp: {金曜日|きんようび}の{夜|よる}、／{妻|つま}と／{駅|えき}で／{会|あ}う／{約束|やくそく}が／ありました。
sentences.en: On Friday evening, I had plans to meet my wife at the station.

sentences.jp: でも、／{妻|つま}は／{来|き}ません。
{七時五分|しちじごふん}に、／メッセージが／{来|き}ました。
sentences.en: At five past seven, a message came.

sentences.en: "It'll take about twenty more minutes to get to the station."

「{出口|でぐち}の／{近|ちか}くだよ。／{本屋|ほんや}の／{隣|となり}。」
sentences.en: "Near the exit. Next to the bookshop."

sentences.jp: {十分|じゅっぷん}／{待|ま}ちました。
でも、／{妻|つま}は／まだ／{来|き}ません。
{電話|でんわ}を／かけた／とき、／{後|うし}ろで／{電話|でんわ}の／{音|おと}が／しました。
sentences.en: When I called her, I heard a phone ringing behind me.

sentences.en: The café was big, and it was full of people.

sentences.en: We had both been waiting in the same café for ten minutes.

sentences.en: We had a good laugh and went off to have dinner.

gist.q: Why didn't they find each other at first?
options: They were in the same big, crowded café
The husband went to the wrong station
